risks.title: Inflation and cost pressures
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited in first section of 10-K, with strong language on negative inflation impact on costs (fuel, wages). Dependence on customer price increases to offset costs represents significant vulnerability, especially during recession. Macro category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Coyote integration and associated costs
risks.score_rationale: Factor central to 2024-2025 results, with $49M integration costs in 2024 and $19M in 2025. Increased integration expenses, margin dilution and operational integration failure risks clearly exposed. Capital category heavily impacted.

risks.title: Dependence on freight market conditions
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes that capacity contraction in certain regions drove procurement costs higher than selling prices, directly impacting margins. This misalignment is described as current and recurring phenomenon, with urgent language ('rapidly exiting capacity').

risks.title: Risk of debt covenant non-compliance
risks.score_rationale: 10-K explicitly mentions that any covenant default could have material negative effect on liquidity. Covenant ratio modifications (4.5x leverage) following Coyote acquisition show increased exposure. 2026 credit renewal confirms required vigilance.

risks.title: Operating cash flow deterioration
risks.score_rationale: 2024 operating cash was negative (-$12M), though positive in 2025 (+$51M). Volatility linked to net losses and working capital variations. Risk is moderate but real if losses persist.

risks.title: Asset quality deterioration
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill impairment of $12M reported for ground and air express unit. Indicates underperformance of strategic unit. Though modest amount, reflects risk of post-acquisition overvaluation or business perspective shift.

ai_positioning.summary: RXO does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. Information provided focuses on financial aspects, business segments and company operations, with no reference to AI or its applications.
